description: Use this tool to build a project using Unix make named ‚Makefile‘. The Parameter ‚makeFile‘ must contain a full qualfied file name. This tool is applicable for Unix make file projects. This tool provides information about the validity of the changes. If errors occur, try to fix them. Always show the content of parameter ‚stdout’ and ‚stderr‘.

makeFile.description: This parameter defines the Unix make file ‚Makefile’ to build a project.
makeFile.name: makeFile

name: clang_make

stderr.description: Always show the content of parameter ‚stderr‘.
stderr.name: stderr

stdout.description: Always show the content of parameter ‚stdout‘.
stdout.name: stdout
